plan.title: Attribution ledger for the four value signal classes

narratives.Description: Record value, bypass, adoption, and friction signal classes on directive's existing emit-only events infrastructure, each entry flag-gated by the value-feedback policy. Wire a few high-signal sources first so the ledger is credible rather than noisy.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Extend the events registry and emit helper module to accept the four signal-class event types behind the policy gate.
- Wire initial gate-catch and WIP-cap-protect sources and add tests asserting entries reach the events ledger only when enabled.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive consumer, I want value and bypass events recorded to a local ledger, so that later readbacks can attribute concrete claims to real events.
narratives.Traces: #1709 attribution ledger (child 2); events infra scripts/_events.py / events/registry.json.

narrative.Acceptance: The ledger records value, bypass, adoption, and friction events each tagged with a signal class.
When the policy flag is off, no ledger entries are emitted for any wired source.
Each wired gate-catch and WIP-cap source records ledger entries that persist across the session.

expected_outputs: Four-class attribution ledger gated on the value-feedback flag

references.title: Issue #1709: Epic: Directive value attribution & adoption loop (RFC)
